messages:
alex p: Quick perf question — I'm scheduling smoke throughput runs to validate continuous-batching tuning changes (max_batch 128 -> adaptive, queue_ms 20 -> 10). Can someone run on staging-3 today? Need tokens/sec, p50/p95 token latency, and queue length distribution.

maria c: I can run a couple. Which model and payload sizes?

alex p: Thanks — model: gpt-7b-quant, seq_len: 512 and 2048, batch size sweep: [8,16,32,64,128]. Use eval_prompts/latency_set_v2. Keep prefix caching on. Output tokens ~256.

ryan l: FYI we had a regression last week where reducing queue_ms to 5 caused queue starvation at burst. Do we want to try 10 and 20 first?

tia s: +1 to 10/20. Also add max_wait_ms alarm at 200ms so SRE can catch it.

alex p: Good call. Plan: run 3 warmup runs, then 10 measured runs per config. Collect: tokens/sec, p50/p95 token latency, tail queue wait, OOMs, kernel async stalls. I'll add a benchmarking job: 
```bash
rdm-bench run --cluster staging-3 --model gpt-7b-q --configs configs/cb_sweep.yml --warmup 3 --runs 10
```

maria c: Running now. Pinging when done.

ci-bot: scheduled benchmark job rdm-bench-1773054321-01 on staging-3. Logs at https://ci.internal/redwood/rdm-bench-1773054321-01

ryan l: small note — ensure quantized kernel variant = "int8-fast" in config, otherwise latency numbers won't be comparable.

alex p: Added to config. Also cc @eng-sre to keep an eye: tia s

tia s: watching. If tail latency spikes, I'll flip fallback-policy to small-model-4b and record failover time.

maria c: first run results (summary): tokens/sec: [1200, 1180, 1215] for batch 32 seq512. p95 token latency ~45ms. Queue wait median 12ms. No OOMs. Full logs / link: https://ci.internal/.../run1

alex p: Awesome. Can you upload raw CSVs to /tmp/perf/1773054321/ and attach kernel traces? I want to compare kernel occupancy.

maria c: uploaded. Also saw a spurious kernel stall at 00:17:03 in run4, adding snippet:
```
WARN kernel: stream stall 42ms nvrtc -> retry
```

ryan l: That stall matches a known driver bug; try pinning CUDA 12.3.2 for next run.

alex p: We'll re-run with pinned driver and queue_ms=10 and 20. If still flaky, try increasing batching target to 150 tokens.

tia s: noted. I'll create an incident ticket if we see >1% request errors.

maria c: re-running now with pinned driver and queue_ms=10. ETA 40m.

alex p: thanks all, will follow up with consolidated metrics and recommended default configs.
